page.layout: One page of text: woodcut ornament band at top; title "LIBER SECUNDUS." and "CAPUT I." centred; then a list of chapter summaries with page references at the right; below, a catchword-like word "LIBER" at the lower right (signature/title-part, treated as text).

main_text.head: LIBER SECUNDUS.
CAPUT I.
main_text.p: PAtrum de fide Ecclesiæ testimonia non esse semper certa veraque. pag.203.
main_text.l: Cap. II. Patres ipsos negare nudis suis assertionibus absolutè standum esse in iis quæ de religione ipsi in medium afferunt. pag.212.
Cap. III. Patres ea ratione scripsisse ut manifestum sit iis inter scribendum, de Religione pronuntiare non fuisse propositum. Eorum in quibus lapsi sunt, & erraverunt exempla quædam. pag.234.
Cap. IV. Patres sive seorsum singulos, sive conjunctim plures, in variis religionis capitibus errasse. pag.252.
Cap. V. Patres inter se aliquando dissentire, & quidem interdum de rebus magni momenti, pag.295.

Cap. VI. Neque Protestantes, neque Pontificios agnoscere Patres Judices rerum ad religionem suam pertinentium, hósque non minùs quam illos quæ ad palatum suum non faciunt nulla religione repuere. Satisfit duabus quæstionibus quæ ex superioribus omnibus oriuntur. pag.305.

page.notes: The first word of the list is a large initial "P" (Patrum); the page-number-like items "pag.203." etc. are references belonging to their lines. The word "LIBER" at lower right is printed alone and may be a catchword or part of a title; treated as text. The ornamental woodcut band is not transcribed. Several letters are faint in the scan (s/f forms rendered as s, as printed in the long-s style of the period).
